title: Benchmarking Training Paradigms, Dataset Composition, and Model Scaling for Child ASR in ESPnet

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance (measured by Word Error Rate) and Speaker Verification performance (measured by Equal Error Rate and minDCF) across different child age groups (4-7, 8-10, and 11-15 years), and analyzing the performance disparity caused by models pre-trained predominantly on adult speech.
